# Test fixtures

Fixed copies of source texts so unit tests don't change when the app's corpora in
`src/corpus/raw` are edited, renamed or removed. Sources and licences are as listed in
`SOURCES.md` (top level); `battle-creek-speech.txt` is a raw speech transcript kept here
only to exercise the text cleaner, and `tinystories-sample.txt` is the first ~600 KB
(whole lines) of the TinyStories corpus.
